application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - Insufficient information has been provided relating to the proposed garage door replacement failing to ensure a high quality of development and failing to accord with policies LP1, LP2, LP3 and LP4 of the Local Plan coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework. Condition 4 cannot therefore be discharged

Reason : 2 - Insufficient information has been provided to ensure that the development will achieve a maximum water use of 110 litres per person per day failing to accord with Council policy LP1, LP2, LP10 of the Local Plan coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework. Condition 5 can therefore not be discharged

Reason : 3 - Insufficient information has been provided to ensure that the proposed refuse arrangement is in the interests of amenity and hygiene, failing to accord with Council policy LP1 and LP2 of the Local Plan coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework. Condition 7 cannot therefore be discharged.

Reason : 4 - In dealing with this application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive manner and the Council has, as far as practicable, sought solutions to problems arising in relation to dealing with the planning application. We have made available detailed advice in the form of our statutory policies in the Local Plan consisting of the Core Strategy, Development Management Policies Document, Supplementary Planning documents and where appropriate the Site Specific Allocations Document as well as offering a full pre application advice service. However, we have been unable to seek solutions to problems as the principle of the proposal is clearly contrary to our statutory policies and negotiation could not overcome the reasons for refusal.
